distinctive_features.feature: Longitudinal student record spanning inquiry, admissions, enrollment, billing, graduation, and alumni engagement.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Keeps lifecycle information connected and can reduce duplicate entry across institutional teams.

distinctive_features.feature: Configurable academic structures, including curricula, credits, grading, progression, and institution-specific terminology.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Supports varied school and higher-education models without imposing one fixed academic structure.

distinctive_features.feature: AI timetable scheduling, exam scheduling, teaching companion, and early-warning tools are documented.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Offers scheduling and student-support functions beyond routine SIS administration; published performance evidence is limited.

distinctive_features.feature: Cloud SaaS and on-premise deployment options.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Lets institutions choose between vendor-hosted infrastructure and greater control of their own environment.

distinctive_features.feature: Dedicated agent portal for recruitment leads, applications, communications, and commission visibility.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Supports institutions recruiting through external representatives, especially in international markets.

distinctive_features.feature: Internship and thesis workflows include employer matching, applications, logbooks, contracts, and grading.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Connects academic administration with work placements and thesis supervision.

distinctive_features.feature: Read/write Consumer API and integrations with major LMS, productivity, payment, and communication tools.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Enables data exchange and can help institutions connect existing systems to the platform.

distinctive_features.feature: Embedded education payment capability through Classter Payments, alongside other payment integrations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Links payment collection to student billing and education-specific payment arrangements.

weaknesses.issue: Implementation and configuration can take time; reviewers mention setup difficulty, bugs, and integration issues.
Complex workflows and numerous features may require training and confuse less technical users.
Some reviewers report rigid workflows for nonstandard institutions and limited customization in particular workflows.
Finance and logistics reports may need adjustment, according to reviewers.
Mobile ratings are weaker than web ratings; complaints include limited functionality, repeated sign-in, and missing homework.
Moodle integration has caused interface problems for at least one reviewer.
Module-based customized pricing makes total cost difficult to estimate; implementation fees are not itemized.
Public sources do not establish SOC 2, FERPA, COPPA, or DPDP attestations.

ai_features: AI timetable scheduling engine; optimization method and independent deployment evidence are not disclosed.
AI exam scheduling, teaching companion, and early-warning tools are listed in the help center; model details and benchmarks are not published.
pricing_model_summary: Module- and active-student-based pricing; a published 1,000-student example totals €25,500 annually for three modules. Annual or bi-annual billing; implementation fees are not itemized.
biggest_strategic_gap: Despite broad SIS and ERP coverage, dedicated safeguarding, special-education case management, general-ledger accounting, and independently evidenced compliance certifications are not documented.
